answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 29718 Country: India Title: I would like to know that can i use tooth brush? it is right or wrong in islamic culture. Question: Assalamalaikum,i would like to know that can i use tooth brush? it is right or wrong in islamic culture. Answer ID: 29718 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 280/280/M=1432) The use of toothbrush is lawful; but the use of miswak is better. Yes, if someone learns definitely about any toothbrush made of pig hair, then its use will not be lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
